2026_01_BUF_HOU.headline: Buffalo’s protection plan meets Houston’s pass-rush strength in a high-leverage opener
2026_01_BUF_HOU.paragraph1: Buffalo’s offense faces an immediate stress test against a Houston defense built to disrupt quarterbacks, making protection and Josh Allen’s decision speed central to the matchup. The Bills also have Ty Johnson and T.J. Sanders listed questionable, while Houston enters with its own injury considerations. If Buffalo can keep Allen out of repeated long-yardage situations, its explosive offense can dictate pace; if the Texans consistently collapse the pocket and win field position, Houston can turn the game into a possession-by-possession fight.
2026_01_BUF_HOU.model_rationale: Buffalo’s ceiling depends on keeping Allen clean enough to create explosives, while Houston’s best route is sustained pressure, controlled field position and limiting scramble-driven conversions.
